stories.title: Flintshire council tenants paying £80 a year for TV aerials under 1999 contract
stories.summary: Council tenants in Flintshire are paying £1.55 a week for communal TV aerials under a contract that dates from 1999, a meeting has heard. stories.title: Hawarden’s new cemetery won’t be in Hawarden, councillor says
stories.summary: The site now proposed for Hawarden’s new cemetery is not in Hawarden, a Flintshire councillor has said, as the council seeks a further £325,000 for the scheme. stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has corrected figures on how quickly it answers the public’s requests for information after a councillor pointed out its sums were wrong. stories.title: Double yellow lines proposed around Oakenholt school
